strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Identify a liquidity grab where price briefly breaks support or resistance and then reverses. Enter at the edge of the candle that made the liquidity grab: for longs, at the top of the grab candle after a sell-side sweep; for shorts, at the bottom of the grab candle after a buy-side sweep.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the liquidity grab wick/level. Take profit at the nearest recent swing level in the opposite direction: recent high for longs, recent low for shorts.

variants.timeframe_note: Works on all time frames; examples shown on multiple charts including daily-context discussion
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Manual identification of the liquidity-grab candle and entry level
variants.target_note: Take profit at a recent swing high/low
variants.transcript_quote: you would enter here set your stop loss right right below the liquidity grab and you're going to set your take profit at a recent high

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Use the indicator to mark the liquidity grab and provide the entry signal before entering
variants.target_note: Same target logic: recent low for shorts, recent high for longs

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches one reversal skeleton only; mentions of 10-candle spacing, divergence, and higher-timeframe support/resistance are confluence filters/improvements, not separate strategies with their own exit logic.
